title: Oracle compilation preserves computation time
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over an alphabet $\Sigma$, let $O$ be a language over $\Sigma$, and let $x,y\in\Sigma^*$ and $t\in\mathbb{N}$. The oracle machine associated with $M$ computes $y$ from $x$ relative to $O$ in exactly $t$ steps if and only if $M$ computes $y$ from $x$ within $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over an alphabet $\Sigma$
